word: Title: Morning At The Cultural Center
answer: Mañana En El Centro Cultural

word: I am going to be born in a story we write today.
answer: Voy a nacer en una historia que escribimos hoy.

word: You force the lid open carefully. [sing, inf]
answer: Obligas la tapa con cuidado.

word: We occupy the main room for the workshop.
answer: Ocupamos el salón principal para el taller.

word: They solve a small issue with the projector.
answer: Resuelven un pequeño problema con el proyector.

word: I forget my notebook on the table.
answer: Olvido mi cuaderno en la mesa.

word: You are going to organize the materials soon. [pl]
answer: Van a organizar los materiales pronto.

word: We order the chairs in a circle.
answer: Ordenamos las sillas en un círculo.

word: They participate with good energy.
answer: Participan con buena energía.

word: You start the activity with a short story. [sing, formal]
answer: Parte la actividad con un cuento corto.

word: We are going to remove the extra chairs later.
answer: Vamos a quitar las sillas extra más tarde.

word: They reflect the theme of the day in their drawings.
answer: Reflejan el tema del día en sus dibujos.

word: I register the new participants.
answer: Registro a los nuevos participantes.

word: You retrieve the markers from the cabinet. [sing, inf]
answer: Recuperas los marcadores del gabinete.

word: We return to the main table to continue.
answer: Regresamos a la mesa principal para continuar.

word: They are going to relate their ideas to the theme.
answer: Van a relacionar sus ideas con el tema.

word: You represent the group with your presentation. [pl]
answer: Representan al grupo con su presentación.

word: I concern myself with keeping the space calm.
answer: Me preocupo por mantener el espacio tranquilo.

word: We pretend to travel through different worlds.
answer: Pretendemos viajar por diferentes mundos.

word: They publish their drawings on the wall.
answer: Publican sus dibujos en la pared.

word: You are going to tour the center after class. [sing, formal]
answer: Va a recorrer el centro después de la clase.

word: I make a small summary of the activity.
answer: Realizo un pequeño resumen de la actividad.

word: We link our ideas to create a final story.
answer: Relacionamos nuestras ideas para crear una historia final.

word: They stop for a moment to rest.
answer: Paran un momento para descansar.

word: You pay attention to every detail. [sing, inf]
answer: Pagas atención a cada detalle.

word: We are going to determine the winner soon.
answer: Vamos a determinar al ganador pronto.
